data.gender_notes: Latha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Latha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Lata' which means 'creeping plant' or 'climbing plant'. In Hindu mythology, Latha represents the goddess of love and beauty. The name is also associated with fresh leaves and new beginnings. It is a beautiful and graceful name for a baby girl. The name Latha carries the meaning “Fresh Leaves” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Latha usually hope their child will grow to embody fresh leaves and live with faith, good character and purpose.
